chunks: Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from 'Asim ibn Sulman
mentioned in the saying of Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, [They are] made to drink from a scalding spring, he said: A sound [like moaning] will be heard from it due to the intensity of its heat.

key_terms.عَيْنٍ آنِيَةٍ: A scalding spring whose water is hot enough to scald the insides of the stomach

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the scalding spring in Surah Al-Ghashiyah?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Kitab al-Zuhd*, the scholar Asim ibn Sulayman interprets the Quranic description of the drink of Hell's inhabitants by attributing an audible 'moan' (anin) to the spring of Aniyah due to its intense heat. This sensory detail, rooted in Shia exegetical tradition, vividly illustrates the physical torment of the damned, transforming the abstract concept of scalding water into a palpable auditory experience of suffering.
